label: Govee H5179 to IoT-Open
info:
Govee Cloud API -> Node-RED -> IoT Open (Lynx) REST publish API.

Before deploying, replace the placeholders (your-...) in the two function nodes:
- 'Build Govee request': Govee API key and Govee device ID (the 'device' value from Govee's device list, not necessarily the MAC address)
- 'Extract + prepare IoT-Open messages': IoT Open API key and installation ID. Also check GOVEE_TEMP_UNIT.

Never export or commit this flow with real keys filled in.
